.engramdb/memories/tax-uses-round-half-even_01a0f90f-fd4f-7f50-9509-aeb8dcc57e3f.md:15:Tax amounts are rounded with banker's rounding (`decimal.ROUND_HALF_EVEN`), as decided with the finance team in March 2026. Do not use ROUND_HALF_UP.

Tax uses **banker's rounding**, `decimal.ROUND_HALF_EVEN`. The finance team decided this in March 2026, and the project's EngramDB memory records it (don't use `ROUND_HALF_UP`).

I couldn't confirm it in the code. A search for `ROUND_`, `quantize` and `round(` found no rounding calls in the repo, only the memory file itself. So the rule is documented, but no tax code that implements it exists yet.
